wholePhysicalScope: Named DCGIS-derived 23-vertex church outline and the exact March 2020 Kurtkaiser CC0 original, with the church history and National Register district record.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the square belfry, Gothic tracery, three recessed portals and attached annex. Near levels add the stone profiles, steps and louvers.
limitations: The March 2020 image controls the east front and bell tower. The rear roof and wall details, southern annex elevations and unsurveyed heights are approximate.
Stone tracery, stained-glass colors and porch relief are original simplified geometry. The modern front photographs cover the street-facing details.
The independent elevation field is preserved. Entrance steps and their pavement contact are approximate.
